'''Hohn Ryntz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ryntz worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]], as an internal audit clerk. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he was tasked by [[Velin Wir]], the Cartel's envoy to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], to place a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[heroes of Cularin]]. However, following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Wir, he forgot to cancel the bounty.

Following the [[Cularin's disappearance|reappearance of the Cularin system]] just over ten years later, various [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] became interested in the contract, which, due to compound interest, was now valued at half a million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Ryntz felt indebted to the heroes, as they had prevented the release of a deadly virus on the [[Caarimon|Caarite homeworld]], and he wanted to avoid a PR scandal for the Cartel, so he tried to track them down and warn them. He found them on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he told them about the bounty and attempted to contact the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], so that he could cancel the contract.
